_comment: GATED mutation lane (Core-Laws-and-Precedents.md). Pinned to the highest-stakes pure modules — prompt assembly + credential resolution — where a surviving mutant means a test asserts presence-of-behavior without asserting correctness (the `isVllmBackend`-lying-gate class neo founded this on). Unlike the exploratory stryker.config.json (break:null), this FAILS the build below `thresholds.break` — a ratchet-down regression guard. NOT in `pnpm check` (mutation runs are minutes; the check budget is structural-fast) — run on demand via `pnpm test:mutation:gate` + from CI. RUNNABLE (PD-114): both target files + their tests exist; `break` stays null until calibrated from a measured run.
_plugins_comment: Explicit plugin paths — pnpm's strict layout breaks Stryker auto-discovery.
_reporters_comment: `progress` is NOT optional here, unlike in the exploratory config where it was already present. The mutant phase over 1,115 mutants emits NOTHING without it: a 2026-08-14 calibration run sat 56+ minutes past a successful dry run with zero output, indistinguishable from a wedge, and there was no way to tell a slow run from a hung one. A gate whose expensive phase is a black box cannot be operated.
_mutate_comment: EXACTLY the highest-stakes files — no globs. Keep tight: break is calibrated to this set's measured score. (PD-114 dropped the phantom domain/chat/routing.ts — prompt assembly is assembly/assemble.ts.) The AP-C2 rider (D60, agent-principal-design/07 §4) adds the AGENT CEILING (domain/admin/guard.ts — canAgent, the closed allow-union kill switch) + the SPEAKER→ATTRIBUTION map (domain/chat/engine/round.ts — buildSpeakerPrep, the agent self-attribution arm authorUserId=speaker.ref.userId): a surviving mutant there means the containment/attribution tests assert presence-of-behavior without asserting correctness. Covered by tests/server/domain/admin/guard.test.ts (unit) + tests/server/domain/chat/engine/round.int.test.ts (integration).
_ignore_comment: Prune the sandbox copy — same shape as the base config. .cache/** (8.8G vLLM venv; its lib64 symlink crashes copyfile EISDIR) and .models/** (25G HF weights) MUST be excluded or the sandbox copy explodes. data/** + *.db* (the dev database) are pruned too — ignorePatterns is ACTIVE now that the sandbox patch makes a NORMAL sandbox work (it was a no-op under the old --inPlace). Stryker does NOT read .gitignore, so every gitignored artifact tree needs an explicit entry here: the scripts/probes/st-goldens/** block is the ST-parity probe's captured FOREIGN SillyTavern install + its generated fixtures/outputs (.gitignore:104-108, and excluded the same way by tsconfig.json:135-141) — 2,196 runtime files that the 4 mutation targets have nothing to do with, and whose unterminated-tag HTML made the DisableTypeChecksPreprocessor emit a parse warning on every run (audit RC-02, 2026-08-13). Measured: 7358 -> 5162 project files at startup, warning gone.
_coverage_comment: coverageAnalysis NOT set — the vitest-runner ignores it and always uses perTest.
_dryruntimeout_comment: Stryker's DEFAULT dryRunTimeoutMinutes is 5, and the initial run blew through it at exactly 5:02 (05:14:40 -> 05:19:42, `Initial test run timed out!`) — the third of three invisible blockers that kept this gate from EVER producing a score. The dry run executes the whole unit+integration+contract set to collect perTest coverage, and the runner pins `maxThreads:1`/`maxConcurrency:1` (vitest-test-runner.js:36-49), so ~1,300 files that take 7.3 min of wall time across 14 parallel forks run ONE AT A TIME here. This is the documented knob for exactly that; keep it comfortably above the measured dry-run duration recorded in the thresholds comment.
_concurrency_comment: 24-core / 125GB box; default is n-1 (=23). 16 → ~8 checker + ~8 runner processes with headroom. Bump toward 20 for a dedicated run.
_thresholds_comment: break is the GATE - Stryker exits non-zero when the AGGREGATE score across the pinned files drops below it. CALIBRATED 2026-08-14 from the FIRST completed run in this gate's history (run 5, 84m03s, worktree agent-adeeb7c0ae82ce38c): measured total 55.56 / covered 58.02 (guard 63.64, assemble 52.25, round 81.97, resolve 50.00). break=50 sits a few points under the measured floor as a REGRESSION catch, not an aspiration. CAVEAT: the run fought load 40-60 and logged 503 mutant ERRORS (excluded from the score denominator) - a quiet-box rerun (pnpm test:mutation:gate, ~23min dry + ~60min mutants) will give a cleaner denominator and may justify raising break. The four runnability blockers and their receipts live in this file's history (4d067d7ac, 81d8b1b39).
